{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
qa_rows = sales[qa_mask]

# Count QA rows in the full dataset
num_qa_in_full = len(qa_rows)

# Filter QA rows from loyal_completed
real_orders = loyal_completed[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = real_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Print required numbers
print(f'Number of QA rows in full dataset: {num_qa_in_full}')
print(f'Number of loyal completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'Number of QA rows among loyal completed orders: {len(qa_rows[qa_rows["customer_segment"] == "loyal"])}')
print(f'Number of valid loyal completed orders after removing QA: {len(real_orders)}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')"}
